name: Artemis
abilities: Ares: Olympian Verdict Contest Sundering Trial
passives: Aegis Favor: Ares gains Favor when breaker play marks armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture on marble thunder line. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a divine contest law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of High Olympian courts.
lore: Artemis, Moon Huntress, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Olympian. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: moon hunt goddess, wild threshold guardian, bow discipline and sudden punishment. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses moon hunt goddess, wild threshold guardian, bow discipline and sudden punishment; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Olympian canon.
visualDescription: Artemis manifests as moon hunt goddess, wild threshold guardian, bow discipline and sudden punishment from Olympian: beautiful young feminine hunter face, sharp clear eyes, straight nose, alert lips, untamed focus; athletic feminine archer frame, long legs, narrow waist, strong hips, poised running stance; signature silhouette: crescent bow arc, high hunt-braid, short chiton armor, stag-horn moon ornaments. Weapon: silver crescent bow and short hunting spear. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Ares — Aegis Spear Thrust Rend
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Olympian source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Laurel Favor gain when used from trial-marked arena ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Laurel Trial Technique — Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Builds Laurel Favor only when the Avatar uses trial-marked arena ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Ares: Olympian Verdict Contest Sundering Trial
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Laurel Favor to impose a two-round rule from Celestial Heights of Olympus: breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Nike Crowned Ascension
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Laurel Favor, transform nearby terrain into trial-marked arena ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Ares Sunderer Aegis Laurel Spear
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through trial-marked arena ground. Visual: living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Ares Living Marble Bronze Cuirass
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Celestial Heights of Olympus source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Ares Oracle Ambrosia Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Laurel Favor and unlocks a mastery branch for Hermes Crossing Step, Athena Countermeasure, and Claim the Laurel. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Ares's Aegis Favor: a solo mechanic where Favor grows through marble thunder line, reaction-window mastery, and breaker decisions that mark armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture. Payoff: turn correct sequencing into burst windows against bosses and shields. Counterplay: mistimed burst leaves the Deity exposed during recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: mistimed burst leaves the Deity exposed during recovery
